ogre.name: Ground Slam
ogre.description: Hits every hero for its damage −2 and knocks its target prone

goblinToss.name: Goblin Toss
goblinToss.description: Hurls one of its goblins over your front line at the lowest-HP hero for 1.5× its damage (taunts can't stop a throw; the goblin is spent). With no goblins left, it uses Ground Slam instead

assassin.name: Execute
assassin.description: Double damage to a hero below half HP

warlock.name: Hex
warlock.description: Curses the party (−2 damage for 2 turns) and deals 3 to every hero, ignoring armor

shaman.name: War Drum
shaman.description: Beats the drum before the horde acts: every monster deals +2 damage this round

chieftain.name: Call the Pack
chieftain.description: Two fresh goblins join the fight

raiseDead.name: Raise Dead
raiseDead.description: Every skeleton that crumbled from weapon hits rises again at 2 HP, fighting from next round. Fire and holy kills stay down

lich.name: Death Bolt
lich.description: Blasts the lowest-HP hero for 1.5× damage, ignoring armor

packTactics.name: Pack Tactics
packTactics.description: +1 damage for each other goblin minion on the field

packGuard.name: Guarded by the Pack
packGuard.description: Can't be targeted while 2 or more goblins are alive; attacks that hit every enemy still land

chieftainCommand.name: Chieftain's Command
chieftainCommand.description: Every goblin deals +1 damage while the Chieftain lives

restlessDead.name: Restless Dead
restlessDead.description: A fallen skeleton reassembles at the start of next round with half its HP: 8, 4, then 2. At 2 HP the next hit ends it. Fire and holy damage destroy it for good

phylactery.name: Phylactery
phylactery.description: The Lich takes half damage while its Phylactery stands. The Phylactery can't be targeted while any skeleton stands (attacks that hit every enemy still land)
